non_material_deviations.description: The installed experiment skill's bash_exec, memory, and artifact-store surfaces were unavailable in Codex App. PLAN.md, CHECKLIST.md, repository artifacts, pytest, git, and GitHub Actions supplied equivalent durable evidence.
Default pytest temporary roots were not writable to the sandbox identity. Final tests used disposable repository-local basetemp directories, which were removed afterward.
A historical CQC test writes a tracked validation report, so the full CQC suite was executed in a disposable exact-SHA clone. The contract-frozen CQC checkout remained at the same SHA and clean.
The first Package C live attempt was blocked by sandbox network restrictions; the approved-network rerun returned HTTP 200 and three CandidatePointers before STOP.

The first implementation commit serialized generated JSON with CRLF. A verified source correction normalized JSON to LF and changed the generators to request LF explicitly; the corrected SHA is the evaluated source SHA.
